PitchEmailAgent.subject: Henry x Orchard Card Bar — 3 honest in-store breaks
PitchEmailAgent.body:
Hi Orchard Card Bar,

I'm Henry Lim. I open Pokémon product for collectors in Singapore who are deciding whether to spend — verdicts, not hype, and I never re-film a pull.

Your shop floor is busy every weekend and there is no video anywhere. I'd like a 3-post trial filmed in-store: a repack verdict, a graded-card reveal, and an honest 'what I'd actually buy off your shelf'. No invented pull rates, no guaranteed-hit language.

15 min call this week?
Henry
